scientific_integrity: Finite exact enumeration supports explicit analytic identities; the general result is proved by conditional fixed-count sampling and a monotonicity covariance identity.
scientific_limitations: Balanced equal-size samples and atomless common null; the Wasserstein covariance requires finite first moment. Local monotone additive functionals only; no claim of general stochastic ordering, maximum-deviation signs, or independent validation. Historical priority may include earlier implicit proofs.
title: Exact quadratic bridge regression and negative runs–Wasserstein dependence
